def predict_next_value(current_hex_value):
    """Predicts the next hexadecimal value assuming counter incrementation.


    Args:
        current_hex_value: The current hexadecimal value as a string. Assumes the
                           structure KEY:SN:Btn:Cnt (e.g., "0xE8C1619E801C")


    Returns:
        The predicted next hexadecimal value as a string.
    """


    prefix = current_hex_value[:-4]  # Everything except the last 4 characters
    counter_hex = current_hex_value[-4:] 
    counter_int = int(counter_hex, 16) 
    next_counter_int = counter_int + 1 
    next_counter_hex = hex(next_counter_int)[2:].upper().zfill(4)  
    return prefix + next_counter_hex


# Example Usage:
values = [
    "0E8C1619E801B",  # Representative prefix
    "0E8C1619E801C",  
    "0E8C1619E830C",  
    "0E8C1619E830D", 
    "0E8C1619E830E", 
    "0E8C1619E830F"   
]


for value in values:
    next_value = predict_next_value(value)
    print(f"Next value after {value}: {next_value}")






#include <iostream>
#include <string>
#include <iomanip>
#include <sstream>


std::string predict_next_value(const std::string& current_hex_value) {
    // Separate prefix and counter
    std::string prefix = current_hex_value.substr(0, current_hex_value.size() - 4);
    std::string counter_hex = current_hex_value.substr(current_hex_value.size() - 4);


    // Convert counter from hex to integer
    int counter_int = std::stoi(counter_hex, nullptr, 16);


    // Increment the counter
    counter_int++;


    // Convert counter back to hex string
    std::stringstream ss;
    ss << std::hex << std::uppercase << std::setw(4) << std::setfill('0') << counter_int;
    std::string next_counter_hex = ss.str();


    // Construct the new value
    return prefix + next_counter_hex;
}


int main() {
    std::vector<std::string> values = {
    "0E8C1619E801B",  # Representative prefix
    "0E8C1619E801C",  
    "0E8C1619E830C",     "0E8C1619E830D", 
    "0E8C1619E830E", 
    "0E8C1619E830F"   
    };


    for (const auto& value : values) {
        std::string next_value = predict_next_value(value);
        std::cout << "Next value after " << value << ": " << next_value << std::endl;
    }


    return 0;
}
